# Ayush Yadav — Portfolio (long-form LLM index)

> Companion to [llms.txt](llms.txt). This file gives language models a denser tour
> of the codebase: what each major folder does, the load-bearing decisions, how the
> i18n pipeline works end-to-end, and a glossary of conventions. Read alongside
> [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), which states the hard rules.

## Identity

Personal portfolio for **Ayush Yadav** (R&D Software Engineer II, Cadence Design
Systems, Noida). Showcases performance-engineering work on the Xcelium logic
simulator, the XMAI agentic profiler, the AlgoLens algorithm visualizer, and a
handful of open-source / competitive-programming projects.

License is **proprietary** — see `LICENSE`. Viewing for personal study is allowed;
copying, fork-and-publishing, or training ML models on the source is **not** allowed
without prior written permission.

## Stack

| Layer         | Choice                                                                  |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Framework     | Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack) on Node 22                           |
| Language      | TypeScript 6 strict + `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`                        |
| Styling       | Tailwind CSS 4 with HSL CSS-variable design tokens                      |
| UI primitives | Radix UI, `cmdk`, `lucide-react`                                        |
| Animation     | framer-motion (always gated on `useReducedMotion()`)                    |
| i18n          | next-intl 4 with `localePrefix: "never"`                                |
| Validation    | Zod 4 (server-side schema; codes mapped to translations on the client)  |
| Email         | Resend (Node runtime, soft-success in development)                      |
| Testing       | Vitest + Testing Library for units; Playwright + axe-core for e2e/a11y  |
| Lint / format | ESLint 10 (flat config) + jsx-a11y, Prettier with Tailwind plugin       |
| Hooks         | Husky (pre-commit format, commit-msg conventional, pre-push full gate)  |
| CI            | GitHub Actions: CI, Security (CodeQL + audit + dep-review), E2E, Stale  |

## Load-bearing decisions

1. **`localePrefix: "never"`**. Every page lives at a single canonical URL across
   all six locales. The active locale is resolved server-side from the
   `NEXT_LOCALE` cookie + `Accept-Language` header. See
   `docs/ADR/0004-i18n-next-intl.md`.
2. **Server components by default.** Client islands are added only where state,
   effects, or browser APIs are required (`hero`, `command-menu`, `theme-toggle`,
   project demos, etc.).
3. **Content as code.** Every fact shown on the site is sourced from
   `src/content/*.ts`. Components never inline strings; they read from these files.
4. **Translations as overlay.** `messages/en.json` is complete; other locales are
   partial overlays merged on top of English so missing keys silently fall back.
5. **Coverage scoped to `src/lib/**`.** UI is tested through Playwright; the
   pure-logic layer carries the strict thresholds (90/80/90/90).
6. **Animation policy.** Every continuous animation either pauses off-screen
   (`InView` wrapper) or finalizes instantly when `prefers-reduced-motion` is set.
7. **Security headers.** CSP, HSTS preload (2 years), COOP same-origin, CORP
   same-origin, restrictive Permissions-Policy. See `next.config.mjs`.

## Directory map

```text
src/
  app/
    layout.tsx               # Root layout (<html lang>, fonts, themes)
    icon.jpg                 # Phoenix favicon
    apple-icon.jpg
    [locale]/
      layout.tsx             # Locale layout: providers, header/footer, JSON-LD, command menu
      page.tsx               # Home (recruiter-aware composition)
      about/page.tsx         # About + beyond-work + honors + certs
      work/page.tsx          # Work index + GitHub workbench
      work/[slug]/page.tsx   # Case-study template (per-project demo + diagram routing)
      experience/page.tsx    # Career timeline + internships + education
      skills/page.tsx        # Skills explorer + engineering spectrum
      competitive-programming/page.tsx  # CP command center + roadmap diagram + concepts
      feeds/page.tsx         # Live Medium / YouTube / GitHub feeds
      contact/page.tsx       # Contact info + form
      lab/page.tsx           # Locale-aware redirect to /competitive-programming
      not-found.tsx          # Localized 404
    api/contact/route.ts     # POST contact endpoint (Zod + rate-limit + Resend)
    opengraph-image.tsx      # Edge-runtime OG image generator
    sitemap.ts               # One URL per route
    robots.ts                # Robots policy
    globals.css              # Tailwind 4 entry + CSS-var tokens + @utility classes

  components/
    layout/                  # Site header, footer, command menu, language switcher,
                             # recruiter mode + banner + toggle, mobile action bar,
                             # scroll FAB, theme provider/toggle, InView wrapper,
                             # IntlClientProvider, RecruiterAware
    hero/                    # Hero section + animated SVG visualization
    contact/                 # ContactForm, ContactCTA, EmailField (ghost autocomplete)
    projects/                # Featured grid + seven *-demo.tsx components
    experience/              # CareerTimeline + CompanyLogo (3-stage fallback)
    skills/                  # SkillsExplorer + EngineeringSpectrum
    competitive-programming/ # CPCommandCenter
    feeds/                   # ActivityFeeds (server component)
    diagrams/                # XMAI architecture, case-study thumbs, roadmap diagram
    metrics/                 # Homepage MetricsStrip
    quotes/                  # Quote cycler for the footer
    logos/                   # TechMarquee + monochrome tech glyphs + SkillChip
    icons/                   # GitHub/LinkedIn/YouTube brand glyphs
    certs/                   # CertPreview (PDF or image)
    github/                  # GithubWorkbench (filtered repo grid)
    about-section.tsx
    concept-labs.tsx

  content/                   # Single source of truth for all page content
  i18n/                      # routing.ts, navigation.ts, request.ts
  lib/                       # validation, email, rate-limit, feeds, github, utils
  proxy.ts                   # next-intl proxy (Next 16 rename of middleware)

messages/{en,hi,ja,sa,zh,ru}.json  # Translated UI strings
public/assets/                     # Logos, certificates, profile picture, resume PDF
tests/                             # Playwright e2e (navigation, contact, a11y, i18n)
docs/                              # Architecture, design guide, ADRs, policy docs
.github/                           # CI workflows, CODEOWNERS, dependabot, templates, copilot-instructions
.cursor/rules/                     # Cursor agent rules (MDC)
.husky/                            # pre-commit / commit-msg / pre-push hooks
scripts/adr-new.mjs                # `npm run adr -- "Title"` ADR scaffolder
```

## How i18n actually works

1. User hits `/work` (no locale prefix).
2. `src/proxy.ts` runs the next-intl middleware: it reads the `NEXT_LOCALE` cookie
   first, then falls back to `Accept-Language`, then to `routing.defaultLocale`.
3. The proxy internally rewrites the URL to `/{locale}/work` so the file-system
   router still routes to `src/app/[locale]/work/page.tsx`. The **browser-visible
   URL is unchanged.**
4. `src/i18n/request.ts` deep-merges `messages/en.json` (base) with the
   locale-specific overlay, so missing keys fall back to English silently.
5. The page component calls `setRequestLocale(locale)` so SSG can bake the right
   translations into the static output.
6. `src/app/layout.tsx` reads `getLocale()` to set `<html lang>`.
7. The language switcher (`src/components/layout/language-switcher.tsx`) calls
   `router.replace(pathname, { locale })` (writes `NEXT_LOCALE`) followed by
   `router.refresh()` (re-fetches server components). The URL doesn't move.

## Hard rules (mirrored from AGENTS.md)

- TypeScript strict + `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`. `arr[0]` is `T | undefined`.
- Server components by default. `"use client"` only when needed.
- No raw `<img>` except `src/components/experience/company-logo.tsx`.
- No new `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
- Animations gated on `useReducedMotion()`. Always.
- External `<a>` uses `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
- Locale-aware imports from `@/i18n/navigation`; never `next/link` / `next/navigation`
  for internal routes.
- `setRequestLocale(locale)` in every server `page.tsx`.
- All user-visible strings come from `messages/en.json` via `t()`.
- Tailwind tokens only. No raw hex colors.
- Conventional Commits enforced (subject ≤ 100 chars).
- `--max-warnings=0`: zero ESLint warnings tolerated.
- Coverage thresholds on `src/lib/**` + `email-field.tsx`: lines ≥ 90, statements ≥ 90,
  functions ≥ 90, branches ≥ 80.

## Glossary

- **Recruiter mode** — toggle in the header that condenses the homepage into an
  impact-first composition. Persists in `localStorage`. See `recruiter-mode.tsx`.
- **Phoenix theme** — warm-ember palette, the project's default theme. The other
  two themes are `light` and `dark`.
- **Concept Lab / roadmap** — entries in `src/content/concepts.ts` that are
  explicitly labelled as design/prototyping (`TraceMind`, `SiliconGraph`,
  `InfraLens`). They are not shipped projects.
- **Workbench** — the live GitHub repo grid on `/work`, sourced via the REST API
  with a hand-curated fallback in `src/lib/github.ts`.
- **Honeypot field** — invisible `website` input in the contact form. Bots fill
  it; humans don't; the API silently soft-succeeds when it's non-empty.
- **Mono label** — small uppercase monospace eyebrow text (`text-[11px]`,
  `tracking-widest`, `text-fg-subtle`). Defined as a Tailwind 4 `@utility`.

## Running the quality gate locally

```sh
npm run format          # write
npm run lint            # eslint, --max-warnings=0
npm run lint:md         # markdownlint
npm run typecheck       # tsc --noEmit
npm test -- --run       # vitest single run
npm run test:coverage   # vitest + v8 thresholds
npm run build           # next build (Turbopack)
npm run test:e2e:build  # build + playwright
```
